en.text: Belshazzar the king made a great feast to a thousand of his lords, and drank wine before the thousand.

zhSimplified.text: 伯沙撒王为他的一千大臣设摆盛筵，与这一千人对面饮酒。

zhTraditional.text: 伯沙撒王為他的一千大臣設擺盛筵，與這一千人對面飲酒。

en.text: Belshazzar, while he tasted the wine, commanded that the golden and silver vessels which Nebuchadnezzar his father had taken out of the temple which was in Jerusalem be brought to him, that the king and his lords, his wives and his concubines, might drink from them.

zhSimplified.text: 伯沙撒欢饮之间，吩咐人将他父尼布甲尼撒从耶路撒冷殿中所掠的金银器皿拿来，王与大臣、皇后、妃嫔好用这器皿饮酒。

zhTraditional.text: 伯沙撒歡飲之間，吩咐人將他父尼布甲尼撒從耶路撒冷殿中所掠的金銀器皿拿來，王與大臣、皇后、妃嬪好用這器皿飲酒。

en.text: Then they brought the golden vessels that were taken out of the temple of God’s house which was at Jerusalem; and the king and his lords, his wives and his concubines, drank from them.

zhSimplified.text: 于是他们把耶路撒冷 神殿库房中所掠的金器皿拿来，王和大臣、皇后、妃嫔就用这器皿饮酒。

zhTraditional.text: 於是他們把耶路撒冷上帝殿庫房中所掠的金器皿拿來，王和大臣、皇后、妃嬪就用這器皿飲酒。

en.text: They drank wine, and praised the gods of gold, and of silver, of bronze, of iron, of wood, and of stone.

zhSimplified.text: 他们饮酒，赞美金、银、铜、铁、木、石所造的神。

zhTraditional.text: 他們飲酒，讚美金、銀、銅、鐵、木、石所造的神。

en.text: In the same hour, the fingers of a man’s hand came out and wrote near the lamp stand on the plaster of the wall of the king’s palace. The king saw the part of the hand that wrote.

zhSimplified.text: 当时，忽有人的指头显出，在王宫与灯台相对的粉墙上写字。王看见写字的指头

zhTraditional.text: 當時，忽有人的指頭顯出，在王宮與燈臺相對的粉牆上寫字。王看見寫字的指頭

en.text: Then the king’s face was changed in him, and his thoughts troubled him; and the joints of his thighs were loosened, and his knees struck one against another.

zhSimplified.text: 就变了脸色，心意惊惶，腰骨好像脱节，双膝彼此相碰，

zhTraditional.text: 就變了臉色，心意驚惶，腰骨好像脫節，雙膝彼此相碰，

en.text: The king cried aloud to bring in the enchanters, the Chaldeans, and the soothsayers. The king spoke and said to the wise men of Babylon, “Whoever reads this writing and shows me its interpretation shall be clothed with purple, and have a chain of gold about his neck, and shall be the third ruler in the kingdom.”

zhSimplified.text: 大声吩咐将用法术的和迦勒底人并观兆的领进来，对巴比伦的哲士说，谁能读这文字，把讲解告诉我，他必身穿紫袍，项带金链，在我国中位列第三。

zhTraditional.text: 大聲吩咐將用法術的和迦勒底人並觀兆的領進來，對巴比倫的哲士說，誰能讀這文字，把講解告訴我，他必身穿紫袍，項帶金鍊，在我國中位列第三。

en.text: Then all the king’s wise men came in; but they could not read the writing, and couldn’t make known to the king the interpretation.

zhSimplified.text: 于是王的一切哲士都进来，却不能读那文字，也不能把讲解告诉王。

zhTraditional.text: 於是王的一切哲士都進來，卻不能讀那文字，也不能把講解告訴王。

en.text: Then King Belshazzar was greatly troubled, and his face was changed in him, and his lords were perplexed.

zhSimplified.text: 伯沙撒王就甚惊惶，脸色改变，他的大臣也都惊奇。

zhTraditional.text: 伯沙撒王就甚驚惶，臉色改變，他的大臣也都驚奇。

en.text: The queen by reason of the words of the king and his lords came into the banquet house. The queen spoke and said, “O king, live forever; don’t let your thoughts trouble you, nor let your face be changed.

zhSimplified.text: 太后因王和他大臣所说的话，就进入宴宫，说：「愿王万岁！你心意不要惊惶，脸面不要变色。

zhTraditional.text: 太后因王和他大臣所說的話，就進入宴宮，說：「願王萬歲！你心意不要驚惶，臉面不要變色。

en.text: There is a man in your kingdom in whom is the spirit of the holy gods; and in the days of your father, light and understanding and wisdom, like the wisdom of the gods, were found in him. The king, Nebuchadnezzar, your father—yes, the king, your father—made him master of the magicians, enchanters, Chaldeans, and soothsayers,

zhSimplified.text: 在你国中有一人，他里头有圣神的灵，你父在世的日子，这人心中光明，又有聪明智慧，好像神的智慧。你父尼布甲尼撒王，就是王的父，立他为术士、用法术的，和迦勒底人，并观兆的领袖。

zhTraditional.text: 在你國中有一人，他裏頭有聖神的靈，你父在世的日子，這人心中光明，又有聰明智慧，好像神的智慧。你父尼布甲尼撒王，就是王的父，立他為術士、用法術的，和迦勒底人，並觀兆的領袖。

en.text: because an excellent spirit, knowledge, understanding, interpreting of dreams, showing of dark sentences, and dissolving of doubts were found in the same Daniel, whom the king named Belteshazzar. Now let Daniel be called, and he will show the interpretation.”

zhSimplified.text: 在他里头有美好的灵性，又有知识聪明，能圆梦，释谜语，解疑惑。这人名叫但以理，尼布甲尼撒王又称他为伯提沙撒，现在可以召他来，他必解明这意思。」

zhTraditional.text: 在他裏頭有美好的靈性，又有知識聰明，能圓夢，釋謎語，解疑惑。這人名叫但以理，尼布甲尼撒王又稱他為伯提沙撒，現在可以召他來，他必解明這意思。」

en.text: Then Daniel was brought in before the king. The king spoke and said to Daniel, “Are you that Daniel of the children of the captivity of Judah, whom the king my father brought out of Judah?

zhSimplified.text: 但以理就被领到王前。王问但以理说：「你是被掳之犹大人中的但以理吗？就是我父王从犹大掳来的吗？

zhTraditional.text: 但以理就被領到王前。王問但以理說：「你是被擄之猶大人中的但以理嗎？就是我父王從猶大擄來的嗎？

en.text: I have heard of you, that the spirit of the gods is in you and that light, understanding, and excellent wisdom are found in you.

zhSimplified.text: 我听说你里头有神的灵，心中光明，又有聪明和美好的智慧。

zhTraditional.text: 我聽說你裏頭有神的靈，心中光明，又有聰明和美好的智慧。

en.text: Now the wise men, the enchanters, have been brought in before me, that they should read this writing, and make known to me its interpretation; but they could not show the interpretation of the thing.

zhSimplified.text: 现在哲士和用法术的都领到我面前，为叫他们读这文字，把讲解告诉我，无奈他们都不能把讲解说出来。

zhTraditional.text: 現在哲士和用法術的都領到我面前，為叫他們讀這文字，把講解告訴我，無奈他們都不能把講解說出來。

en.text: But I have heard of you, that you can give interpretations and dissolve doubts. Now if you can read the writing and make known to me its interpretation, you shall be clothed with purple, and have a chain of gold around your neck, and shall be the third ruler in the kingdom.”

zhSimplified.text: 我听说你善于讲解，能解疑惑；现在你若能读这文字，把讲解告诉我，就必身穿紫袍，项戴金链，在我国中位列第三。」

zhTraditional.text: 我聽說你善於講解，能解疑惑；現在你若能讀這文字，把講解告訴我，就必身穿紫袍，項戴金鍊，在我國中位列第三。」

en.text: Then Daniel answered before the king, “Let your gifts be to yourself, and give your rewards to another. Nevertheless, I will read the writing to the king, and make known to him the interpretation.

zhSimplified.text: 但以理在王面前回答说：「你的赠品可以归你自己，你的赏赐可以归给别人；我却要为王读这文字，把讲解告诉王。

zhTraditional.text: 但以理在王面前回答說：「你的贈品可以歸你自己，你的賞賜可以歸給別人；我卻要為王讀這文字，把講解告訴王。

en.text: “To you, king, the Most High God gave Nebuchadnezzar your father the kingdom, and greatness, and glory, and majesty.

zhSimplified.text: 王啊，至高的 神曾将国位、大权、荣耀、威严赐与你父尼布甲尼撒；

zhTraditional.text: 王啊，至高的上帝曾將國位、大權、榮耀、威嚴賜與你父尼布甲尼撒；

en.text: Because of the greatness that he gave him, all the peoples, nations, and languages trembled and feared before him. He killed whom he wanted to, and he kept alive whom he wanted to. He raised up whom he wanted to, and he put down whom he wanted to.

zhSimplified.text: 因 神所赐他的大权，各方、各国、各族的人都在他面前战兢恐惧。他可以随意生杀，随意升降。

zhTraditional.text: 因上帝所賜他的大權，各方、各國、各族的人都在他面前戰兢恐懼。他可以隨意生殺，隨意升降。

en.text: But when his heart was lifted up, and his spirit was hardened so that he dealt proudly, he was deposed from his kingly throne, and they took his glory from him.

zhSimplified.text: 但他心高气傲，灵也刚愎，甚至行事狂傲，就被革去王位，夺去荣耀。

zhTraditional.text: 但他心高氣傲，靈也剛愎，甚至行事狂傲，就被革去王位，奪去榮耀。

en.text: He was driven from the sons of men, and his heart was made like the animals’, and his dwelling was with the wild donkeys. He was fed with grass like oxen, and his body was wet with the dew of the sky, until he knew that the Most High God rules in the kingdom of men, and that he sets up over it whomever he will.

zhSimplified.text: 他被赶出离开世人，他的心变如兽心，与野驴同居，吃草如牛，身被天露滴湿，等他知道至高的 神在人的国中掌权，凭自己的意旨立人治国。

zhTraditional.text: 他被趕出離開世人，他的心變如獸心，與野驢同居，吃草如牛，身被天露滴濕，等他知道至高的上帝在人的國中掌權，憑自己的意旨立人治國。

en.text: “You, his son, Belshazzar, have not humbled your heart, though you knew all this,

zhSimplified.text: 伯沙撒啊，你是他的儿子，你虽知道这一切，你心仍不自卑，

zhTraditional.text: 伯沙撒啊，你是他的兒子，你雖知道這一切，你心仍不自卑，

en.text: but have lifted up yourself against the Lord of heaven; and they have brought the vessels of his house before you, and you and your lords, your wives, and your concubines, have drunk wine from them. You have praised the gods of silver and gold, of bronze, iron, wood, and stone, which don’t see, or hear, or know; and you have not glorified the God in whose hand your breath is, and whose are all your ways.

zhSimplified.text: 竟向天上的主自高，使人将他殿中的器皿拿到你面前，你和大臣、皇后、妃嫔用这器皿饮酒。你又赞美那不能看、不能听、无知无识、金、银、铜、铁、木、石所造的神，却没有将荣耀归与那手中有你气息，管理你一切行动的 神。

zhTraditional.text: 竟向天上的主自高，使人將他殿中的器皿拿到你面前，你和大臣、皇后、妃嬪用這器皿飲酒。你又讚美那不能看、不能聽、無知無識、金、銀、銅、鐵、木、石所造的神，卻沒有將榮耀歸與那手中有你氣息，管理你一切行動的上帝。

en.text: Then the part of the hand was sent from before him, and this writing was inscribed.

zhSimplified.text: 因此从 神那里显出指头来写这文字。

zhTraditional.text: 因此從上帝那裏顯出指頭來寫這文字。

en.text: “This is the writing that was inscribed: ‘MENE, MENE, TEKEL, UPHARSIN.’

zhSimplified.text: 「所写的文字是：『弥尼，弥尼，提客勒，乌法珥新。』

zhTraditional.text: 「所寫的文字是：『彌尼，彌尼，提客勒，烏法珥新。』

en.text: “This is the interpretation of the thing: MENE: God has counted your kingdom, and brought it to an end.

zhSimplified.text: 讲解是这样：弥尼，就是 神已经数算你国的年日到此完毕。

zhTraditional.text: 講解是這樣：彌尼，就是上帝已經數算你國的年日到此完畢。

en.text: TEKEL: you are weighed in the balances, and are found wanting.

zhSimplified.text: 提客勒，就是你被称在天平里，显出你的亏欠。

zhTraditional.text: 提客勒，就是你被稱在天平裏，顯出你的虧欠。

en.text: PERES: your kingdom is divided, and given to the Medes and Persians.”

zhSimplified.text: 毗勒斯，就是你的国分裂，归与米底亚人和波斯人。」

zhTraditional.text: 毗勒斯，就是你的國分裂，歸與米底亞人和波斯人。」

en.text: Then Belshazzar commanded, and they clothed Daniel with purple, and put a chain of gold about his neck, and made proclamation concerning him, that he should be the third ruler in the kingdom.

zhSimplified.text: 伯沙撒下令，人就把紫袍给但以理穿上，把金链给他戴在颈项上，又传令使他在国中位列第三。

zhTraditional.text: 伯沙撒下令，人就把紫袍給但以理穿上，把金鍊給他戴在頸項上，又傳令使他在國中位列第三。

en.text: In that night Belshazzar the Chaldean King was slain.

zhSimplified.text: 当夜，迦勒底王伯沙撒被杀。

zhTraditional.text: 當夜，迦勒底王伯沙撒被殺。

en.text: Darius the Mede received the kingdom, being about sixty-two years old.

zhSimplified.text: 米底亚人大流士年六十二岁，取了迦勒底国。

zhTraditional.text: 米底亞人大流士年六十二歲，取了迦勒底國。
